o: Puede que haya dejado las luces encendidas. Vuelvo a comprobarlo.
Puede que hayan cogido la carretera equivocada, porque llegan tarde.
Una ronda más antes de terminar. Repite cada frase después de nosotros.
say: One more round before we finish. Repeat each sentence after us.

p: ¿Qué significa «He must have been very angry when he saw the mess.»?
o: Debió de estar muy enfadado cuando vio el desorden.
Debió de estar muy cansada después del largo vuelo.
No puede haber sido fácil mudarse sola a un país nuevo.
say: He must have been very angry when he saw the mess.

p: ¿Qué significa «The cake has disappeared. The dog must have eaten it.»?
o: Puede que haya perdido la cartera cuando estaba en el mercado.
Podríamos haber ganado el partido si hubiéramos jugado mejor.
La tarta ha desaparecido. El perro debe de habérsela comido.
say: The cake has disappeared. The dog must have eaten it.

p: ¿Qué significa «He might have lost his wallet when he was in the market.»?
o: La tarta ha desaparecido. El perro debe de habérsela comido.
No puede haberse olvidado de la reunión. Estaba en su agenda.
Puede que haya perdido la cartera cuando estaba en el mercado.
say: He might have lost his wallet when he was in the market.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «Podríamos haber ganado el partido si hubiéramos jugado mejor.»?
o: She must have been very tired after the long flight.
We could have won the match if we had played better.
They can't have gone far. Their car is still here.
say: We could have won the match if we had played better.

p: Escucha y elige lo que oyes
o: Fourth, after the modal comes have and the past participle. Never of, and never has.
Before the mistakes, one more conversation, about a surprise.
Don't be shy. Speaking out loud is the best way to improve your pronunciation.
say: Fourth, after the modal comes have and the past participle. Never of, and never has.

alt.p: ¿Cómo se dice «Cuarto, después del modal viene have y el participio pasado. Nunca of y nunca has.»?
o: Fourth, after the modal comes have and the past participle. Never of, and never has.
One more round before we finish. Repeat each sentence after us.
Don't be shy. Speaking out loud is the best way to improve your pronunciation.
alt.say: Fourth, after the modal comes have and the past participle. Never of, and never has.

p: Completa: _____ we go.
h: Significa: Allá vamos.
o: Water
Here
Wrong
say: Here we go.

p: Completa: One more round before we finish. Repeat each sentence _____ us.
h: Significa: Una ronda más antes de terminar. Repite cada frase después de nosotros.
o: earlier
country
after
say: One more round before we finish. Repeat each sentence after us.

p: Completa: Did you see Maria this morning? She looked so happy. She must have won _____, or she might have received good news.
h: Significa: ¿Viste a María esta mañana? Parecía tan feliz. Debe de haber ganado algo o puede que haya recibido buenas noticias.
o: anything
meeting
something
say: Did you see Maria this morning? She looked so happy. She must have won something, or she might have received good news.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «La cama está deshecha. Alguien debe de haber dormido aquí.»?
o: They can't have gone far. Their car is still here.
The bed is unmade. Somebody must have slept here.
You should have listened to the doctor's advice.
say: The bed is unmade. Somebody must have slept here.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «Ahora, la forma continua para una acción que estaba en curso. Deben de haber estado durmiendo cuando llamé. Quizá estuviera trabajando hasta tarde.»?
o: Another conversation. Why wasn't Tom at the meeting? I don't know. He might have forgotten about it, or he could have been stuck in traffic.
Someone might have seen him. The neighbor could have noticed something strange. He may have heard the noise of the glass. Let's ask her.
Now, the continuous form for an action that was in progress. They must have been sleeping when I called. She might have been working late.
say: Now, the continuous form for an action that was in progress. They must have been sleeping when I called. She might have been working late.

p: Escucha y elige lo que oyes
o: You should have listened to the doctor's advice.
I shouldn't have believed him. He always lies.
It could have been much worse, so we were lucky.
say: I shouldn't have believed him. He always lies.

alt.p: ¿Cómo se dice «No debería haberle creído. Siempre miente.»?
o: He must have been very angry when he saw the mess.
The bed is unmade. Somebody must have slept here.
I shouldn't have believed him. He always lies.
alt.say: I shouldn't have believed him. He always lies.
